image_first_impression_before_control_co: A warm, calm working portrait in a wet glasshouse. The woman meets the viewer while two hands attend to botanical papers on a wooden screw press. Face, long side hair and the cobalt bow dominate; wet glass, paper stacks and plants make the work setting particular.
scene_grounded_strengths: Hands, specimen sheets and the open wooden press connect into one intelligible task.
Wet panes and bench reflections are visible traces supporting the rain-recovery staging, without proving the earlier leak.
Face and hair remain readable alongside the work surface; the crescent and blue bow are distinct materials.
scene_grounded_limits: The precise scalp-braid start and the braid-to-root terminal are weakened by the generated arrangement and ear occlusion.
The richer invented rescue-after-leak motivation is not independently proved by a still image.
